des: Create a .mcp_server_settings.json file in the data directory. You can pick from the MCP servers below or add your own.
Useful MCP servers will keep being tested and added over time; contributions are welcome.
Remember to remove comment lines; the des property is documentation only and is not parsed.
The des and link properties only document how to install a server and point to its original link; they are optional.
Three transport modes are supported: stdio (standard input/output), sse (Server-Sent Events) and streamable-http (streamable HTTP).

streamable-http-mcp-server.des: Uses the Streamable HTTP transport, suited to production web deployments
